en-US.description: Upload one image to repair and one reference product image to adjust or repair garment style and details with one click.
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.label: Clothing Repair
en-US.maskPainter.help: Paint over the garment area that needs focused repair. AI will prioritize the marked region. If you do not mark anything, AI will detect it automatically.
en-US.maskPainter.noSource: Upload the image to repair first
en-US.refMaskPainter.help: Paint over the garment detail area to extract from the reference product image. AI will transfer the style of that region to the marked area in the image to repair.
en-US.refMaskPainter.noSource: Upload the reference product image first
en-US.repairType.detailRepair.desc: Repair fabric texture, trims, and localized garment details.
en-US.repairType.styleRepair.desc: Correct garment style, silhouette, and structure presentation.
en-US.upload.referenceProductImage.help: Upload one flat-lay, mannequin, or model-shot product image as the garment repair reference.
en-US.upload.sourceImage.help: Upload the model image whose garment needs repair. AI will preserve the person and scene while repairing the clothing.

zh-CN.description: 上传待修复图和参考商品图，一键调整、修复模特身着服饰的款式与细节。
zh-CN.empty.referenceProductImage: 请先上传 1 张参考商品图
zh-CN.empty.sourceImage: 请先上传 1 张待修复图
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.label: 服饰修复
zh-CN.maskPainter.help: 在图上涂抹需要重点修复的服饰区域，AI 将优先处理标记部分。不标记时 AI 自动识别。
zh-CN.refMaskPainter.help: 在参考商品图上涂抹要提取的服饰细节区域，AI 将把该区域的风格迁移到待修复图的标记范围内。
zh-CN.repairType.detailRepair.desc: 修复面料纹理、走线、辅料与局部展示细节。
zh-CN.repairType.styleRepair.desc: 修正模特身着服饰的款式、轮廓与结构表现。
zh-CN.upload.referenceProductImage.help: 支持上传单张平铺图、人台图或模特图，作为服饰款式或细节修复参考。
zh-CN.upload.sourceImage.help: 上传需要修复的模特服饰图，AI 会在保留人物与场景的前提下修正服饰问题。
